title: From Asymptotic to Finite-Sample Minimax Robust Hypothesis Testing
summary: This paper establishes a formal connection between finite-sample and asymptotically minimax robust hypothesis testing under distributional uncertainty. It is shown that, whenever a finite-sample minimax robust test exists, it coincides with the solution of the corresponding asymptotic minimax problem. This result enables the analytical derivation of finite-sample minimax robust tests using asymptotic theory, bypassing the need for heuristic constructions.
